bundle.shortDescription: Audio quality analyzer and transcode detector
bundle.longDescription: Nyquist inspects an audio file and reports whether it is what its container claims: it measures loudness (LUFS, true peak, LRA), dynamic range (DR), spectral content, and looks for the fingerprints of a lossy encoder hidden inside a lossless file, of a bit depth padded wider than the audio behind it, and of a sample rate upsampled past the bandwidth actually present.
